headline: Public hearings on nine traffic petitions, including no-parking zones, stop signs, and a traffic-calming request in East Forest Park.
summary: Items include a 15-minute parking limit at 506 Armory Street, removal of no parking on Wait Street, and an honorary street sign for Bishop Elizabeth Williams. Written comments may be emailed to hvelez@springfieldcityhall.com before or within five days after the hearing.
items: 26-31 SunnyBrook Rd.: no parking to the corner, 90 feet from Parker Street
26-32 Traffic-calming petition for East Forest Park
26-40 Removal of no parking on Wait Street
26-41 No parking on Abbott Street from Plumtree Rd. to Sumner Ave.
26-42 No parking on Beech Street from Central Street to Florence St.
26-43 Honorary street sign for Bishop Elizabeth Williams
26-44 Stop signs at Slater Road and Grayson Drive
26-45 Stop signs for eastbound and westbound vehicles on Windemer Street, with Bowles Park (3-way stop)
